paper_question: Can AI identify ecological blind spots in river DOC monitoring and restore the key ecological patterns with fewer new samples?
anti_switching_clause: Primary endpoints, thresholds, and evaluation scenarios are frozen before the Phase-2 runs. They must not be replaced, redefined, or dropped because results are unfavourable. Any change requires a new version of this file with a written reason and a new frozen_at date; the previous version stays committed.

dataset.sensitivity_only: mixed-type 571-station results (experiments/frozen_results/benchmark*.csv) are historical reference; no headline claim may rest on them

evaluation_scenarios.E1: random missing cells; e1_r{20,40,60}_seed{42,43,44}; equal-weight mean over the 3 masks per rate
evaluation_scenarios.E2a: strict future forecasting; test = observed months after 2020-12; no DOC context in test months; single mask
evaluation_scenarios.E2b: future reconstruction with a running network; 20% post-cutoff observed cells visible as context; single mask
evaluation_scenarios.E3: spatial extrapolation; 20% of stations in the largest component fully held out; e3_spatial_seed{42,43,44}; equal-weight mean over the 3 masks
evaluation_scenarios.mask_note: E3 connectivity is defined on the evaluation graph (dataset.edge_index); the superseded experiments/masks_graphfix_st357 E3 splits used a foreign edge list and must not be used for paper claims
evaluation_scenarios.note: a mean of per-mask R2 is not the pooled R2; aggregation level must be stated with every number

training_seeds.note: identical data, masks, early stopping and seed list for every compared model; seed spread is not per-cell predictive uncertainty

target_basins.source: experiments/kshot_protocol_v2/protocol.json (pilot protocol; its 10% gate is superseded by the Phase-5 gate below)

high_doc_definition.rule: threshold = p-quantile of observed DOC (mg/L) in the training split only; true hotspot: y >= threshold; predicted hotspot: y_pred >= the same mg/L threshold
high_doc_definition.phase5_sampling_hit_rate: additionally report the fraction of drawn samples whose true DOC is >= threshold (acquisition hit rate)

doc_mae.definition: mean absolute error on hidden evaluation cells (mask test split / fixed hidden query set)
doc_mae.co_primary: MAE in log1p(mg/L) space, always reported alongside
doc_mae.aggregation: mean over seeds; E1 and E3 additionally equal-weight over their 3 masks; E2a/E2b single mask
doc_mae.interval: station-clustered bootstrap 95% CI on paired differences (Phase 5: task-month or station-month clustered)

gates.phase2_h2x_vs_best_nongraph: >=10% MAE reduction in at least 2 of {E2a, E2b, E3}
gates.phase2_h2x_vs_h2e: stable gain (paired difference < 0 in >=3 seeds) in at least one extrapolation scenario (E2a or E3)
gates.phase2_e1_noninferiority: E1 performance must not degrade by more than 5% versus the best baseline
gates.phase2_seed_consistency: gain direction consistent in at least 3 of 5 training seeds
gates.phase5_vs_random: at same budget K: >=20% MAE reduction in at least 4 of 5 target basins

high_doc_identification.definition: classification of hidden cells by the fixed mg/L threshold rule (see high_doc_definition)

gates.phase5_vs_random: recall improvement >=20% at same budget in at least 4 of 5 target basins
gates.reporting: tail error contribution and tail coverage must be reported separately in every phase

uncertainty_coverage.interval: central 90% prediction interval from a legal ensemble (5 training seeds or better); uncalibrated seed variance alone is not an uncertainty product

gates.phase3_strata: no major ecological stratum (n >= 50 hidden cells) outside [0.70, 0.98]
gates.phase3_tail: coverage of the high-DOC tail reported separately (top5/top10)
gates.phase3_sanity: uncertainty must vary sensibly with network_distance, ecological_novelty and support_count (monotone direction stated in advance: more distance / more novelty / less support -> more uncertainty)
gates.phase3_isolation: validation strictly against hidden real observations only

gates.phase5_primary: in >=4 of 5 target basins versus random sampling at equal budget: >=20% MAE reduction OR >=20% recall improvement OR >=20% fewer samples to the same error
gates.phase5_no_harm: no single basin may worsen by more than 5% while overall success is claimed
gates.phase5_curve: curves over K in {0,1,3,5} monotone or without clear anomalies
gates.phase5_baselines: at least one simple baseline stably beaten
gates.phase5_leakage: strategies never use query ground-truth DOC

bootstrap.unit_phase2_4: station (clustered resampling of stations with all their rows)
bootstrap.level: 95% CI on paired differences; fixed-model sample-layer intervals are labelled as such and never presented as training-seed uncertainty

secondary_metrics: R2 (mean of per-mask R2 is not pooled R2)
ecological stratum MAE (land cover, climate, soil, stream order)

rules: external region must still beat at least one simple baseline
prediction intervals remain roughly calibrated externally
no re-tuning before reporting external results
on failure: scope narrows to within-basin ecological monitoring design
